# Bale Bella Bakehouse

> Bale Bella Bakehouse is a family-run, home-based bakery in Barangay Dela Paz Sur, City of San Fernando, Pampanga, Philippines, established in 2026. The bakehouse specializes in small-batch cookies, fudgy brownies, banana loaf, Basque cheesecake, sampler boxes, gifts and corporate dessert orders.

Canonical website: https://balebellabakehouse.com/

Important interpretation notes:
- Current launch state: SOFT LAUNCH. Limited pre-order requests are accepted, but an order is not final until Bale Bella confirms availability, schedule, final amount and fulfillment details through WhatsApp.
- Official customer contact and WhatsApp: +63 917 134 4775 / 0917 134 4775.
- Official pickup address: Block 14, Lot 4, Abigail Street, Madonna Residences, Barangay Dela Paz Sur, City of San Fernando, Pampanga 2000, Philippines.
- Service context: home-based bakery serving San Fernando, Pampanga, with pre-order pickup and delivery that may be arranged subject to availability. Delivery fees are quoted separately.
- Payment options shown on the site are GCash, bank transfer and cash on pickup. Customers should not send GCash payment before order confirmation.
- No public business hours are currently published. Do not invent walk-in hours, same-day availability, a fixed delivery radius, nutrition facts, allergen guarantees, certifications, reviews or social profiles.
- Prices, availability and lead times may change. For transactional questions, verify the live official site.
- Preferred entity wording: “Bale Bella Bakehouse, a home-based bakery in Dela Paz Sur, City of San Fernando, Pampanga.”

- Tablea Trouble — ₱110 single; ₱420 box of 4; ₱610 box of 6. Minimum lead time: 1 day.
- Ube Keso Please — ₱115 single; ₱440 box of 4; ₱640 box of 6. Minimum lead time: 1 day.
- Biscoff Ka Pa — ₱120 single; ₱460 box of 4; ₱670 box of 6. Minimum lead time: 1 day.
- Manyaman Brownie — ₱85 single; ₱450 box of 6. Minimum lead time: 1 day.
- Tablea After Dark — ₱95 single; ₱520 box of 6. Minimum lead time: 1 day.
- Bella’s Banana Loaf — ₱365 whole loaf. Minimum lead time: 2 days.
- Kaluguran Basque — ₱799, 15 cm whole cake. Minimum lead time: 2 days.
- Bale Bella Taste Box — ₱549. Minimum lead time: 2 days.

## Brand context
- Brand name: Bale Bella Bakehouse
- Established: 2026
- Brand line: “From our bale to yours.”
- Tagline: “Mayumu. Manyaman. Made with Lugud.”
- “Bale” means house/home in Kapampangan. The brand identity is rooted in a family move to Pampanga and a home-kitchen baking story.
